answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 216 Country: India Title: How Should I Calculate and Perform Qada for Years of Prolonged Haidh? Question: My haidh has always been above ten days. I cannot remember a time when it was below 10 days. Only this month, alhumdulillah, I think it has stopped at 7.5 days. Basically, I bleed for about 6/7 days and then for a day or two, there is nothing, but then afterwards there is tiny amounts of light to dark brown discharge and this continues beyond 10 days. How should I calculate my qada for the past 6.5 years and how much qada should I read everyday? Answer ID: 216 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 357=367/B) As per the condition you described in the question, you should count the ten days as menstruation and you will not have to pray all these ten days. And, after passing ten days you should have bath and start performing salah . In case of bleeding you can do wuzu (when the time of prayer is due) and perform salah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
